title: Soul Prisoner Lifecycle & Captured-Hero Ledger (V1)
designNotes: DESIGN PROPOSAL unless a field is explicitly tagged VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT.
This schema EXTENDS existing persisted hero fields. It does NOT create a second save authority.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: hero capture state already persists via USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem (domain id 'Soul.Campaign', schema version 1) in Source/Soul/Private/SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp CaptureRBSaveDomain_Implementation (lines ~688-730) and RestoreRBSaveDomain_Implementation (lines ~731-903).

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: the authoritative hero struct is FSoulHeroState in Source/SoulCore/Public/SoulHero.h (lines 14-30) with fields HeroId, Condition (ESoulHeroCondition{Healthy,Wounded,Captured}), RecoveryDays, CaptorFaction, CaptureRegion.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: there are exactly TWO persisted hero instances in the Heartland profile today: Hero (player human) and DwarfCommander (NPC). No hero array/registry exists. The ledger below is therefore a per-hero overlay, not a replacement container.

fields.RecoveryDays: int32 (wound clock; 3 on wound, 0 when captured)

verifiedCurrentHeroStateFields.transitionFunction: FSoulHeroRules::ApplyBattleInjury(FSoulHeroState&, bool Wounded, int32 ArmySurvivors, FName Opponent, FName Region) — Source/SoulCore/Private/SoulHero.cpp:54-62. Capture happens iff ArmySurvivors==0; otherwise Wounded with RecoveryDays=3.
verifiedCurrentHeroStateFields.recoveryFunction: FSoulHeroRules::AdvanceRecovery(FSoulHeroState&) — Source/SoulCore/Private/SoulHero.cpp:63-68. GAP: ignores Captured entirely; there is no path out of Captured today.
verifiedCurrentHeroStateFields.savedCapturedInvariant: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT — RestoreRBSaveDomain_Implementation enforces: a Captured hero must have RecoveryDays==0, a canonical captor != owning faction, and a valid CaptureRegion (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp ~lines 858-861 for Hero; ~lines 853-855 for DwarfCommander).

proposedAdditiveFields.placement: Add as additive fields on FSoulHeroState (Source/SoulCore/Public/SoulHero.h). All default to the 'no active prisoner process' value so legacy saves and in-flight captures keep exact current behavior.

CaptureDay.meaning: Economy.Day on which Condition became Captured. 0 == not captured / legacy. Drives ransom valuation decay and deterministic escape clock.

RansomProcess.meaning: State of any active ransom/exchange negotiation for THIS captured hero. None for a non-captured hero.

RansomAskGold.meaning: Deterministically computed gold figure the captor currently asks (captor's offer) OR that the owner has agreed to pay. Recomputed, never random. See ransom_scoring.json.

ExchangeCounterpartHeroId.meaning: For a prisoner-exchange proposal: the HeroId of the other side's prisoner being offered in trade.

capturedHeroLedgerView.note: A LEDGER VIEW is derived, not a new stored container, to avoid a second authority. It is computed on demand from the existing persisted heroes (Hero, DwarfCommander) by scanning for Condition==Captured. If/when Lane 3 introduces a hero registry, the same derivation iterates that registry instead.
capturedHeroLedgerView.derivation: LedgerEntries = { for each persisted FSoulHeroState h where h.Condition==Captured: Entry(h) }

entry.ownerFaction: FName (implicit: 'humans' for Hero, 'dwarves' for DwarfCommander today; VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT the owning faction is implicit, not a field) — see LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED below
entry.heroValueTier: enum {Standard, Commander, Paragon} derived from h.Kind and h.Level

ownerFactionResolution.problem: FSoulHeroState has NO owning-faction field today (VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT, SoulHero.h:14-30). Ownership is implicit via which subsystem field holds the hero (Hero=humans, DwarfCommander=dwarves).
ownerFactionResolution.v1Decision: DESIGN PROPOSAL: do NOT add an owner field in V1. Resolve owner at the call site: player Hero => PlayerFaction (TEXT("humans")), DwarfCommander => TEXT("dwarves"). This matches the existing ApplyHeroInjury opponent-resolution pattern (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp ApplyBattleResult lambda, ~lines 564-577).
ownerFactionResolution.localCheckRequired: If Lane 3 adds a general hero registry with an OwningFaction field, migrate the ledger derivation to read it. Flagged so Codex does not invent an owner field prematurely.

saveContractDelta.schemaVersion: Keep at 1. All new keys are OPTIONAL on read (HasField-guarded) so schema does not need to bump; mirrors how result_mana / result_siege were added as optional schema-1 fields (VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT, SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp ~lines 745-765).
saveContractDelta.npcCommanderMirror: Mirror the same four optional keys inside the existing 'heartland_dwarf_commander' object (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp ~lines 718-723).
saveContractDelta.legacyCompatibility: Absent keys MUST restore to the None/0 defaults so pre-V1 checkpoints remain byte-stable through CaptureRBSaveDomain (same guarantee the diplomacy block already provides via CaptureDiplomacy early-return, SoulHeartlandDiplomacy.cpp:39).
saveContractDelta.adversarialValidation: Restore MUST reject (atomic, no partial mutation) any snapshot where: process!=None but condition!=Captured; capture_day>day; ransom_ask out of [0,100000]; exchange_counterpart set but process!=ExchangeProposed. Reuse the existing 'validate into temporaries, mutate only if Valid' pattern (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp:731-903).
